signal: 365 Retail Markets completed its $848M acquisition of Cantaloupe in May 2026, combining self-checkout with payments and a global device network.

email.body1:
Bill, saw 365 Retail Markets closed the Cantaloupe acquisition, pulling payments and a global device network into the self-checkout platform.

A deal that size usually creates a much bigger North American account map than the team can cover before momentum fades. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for 365 off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Bill, quick follow-up for 365 Retail Markets.

After a big acquisition, cross-sell targets usually jump faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book against the combined base, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings North America needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Bill, last bit of proof for 365 Retail Markets.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how 365's reply rate likely compares to other unattended-retail platforms. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Bill, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling North American coverage without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Integrating a major acquisition is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a self-service retail motion? I'll tailor it to 365 either way.
